specificFindings: Talking to a stranger is compared with participants own expectations; no universal guarantee is inferred.
Replication means further research reproduced findings, not mere media coverage or guaranteed future success; extravert results are distinguished from fake-smile results.
Anagram study condition manipulates pressure to be happy, not tenure, phones or an invented task instruction.
In short summarises the preceding double pressure; many is not all Americans.
New York experiences are first-person anecdotes, not randomised studies; insulted is the author own feeling, not a full proof of others motives.
Cocky dialogue is carefully attributed to Kahneman versus the advisor. Survive is figurative and I suppose retains subjective qualification.
Personal music, singing and wife conversations are alternatives, not mandatory steps or a guaranteed treatment.
Divorce and custody are a hypothetical might reinterpret example, not factual biography or advice on legal arrangements. Dampen could means possible reduction, not elimination.
Five-year question is imagined future perspective, not a longitudinal study.
Time heals everything is a reported belief which the narrator endorses; questions identify reference and stance rather than converting rhetoric into every-case clinical guarantees.
Psychological immune system is attributed to named researchers and explained as a psychological recovery analogy, not discovery of a physical immune organ.
Questions4,18,23,24 carry exact relevant context for logical summary, song reference and pronouns; coverage counts immutable IDs only once.

Before publication, distractors were individually revised toward plausible condition, role, chronology and scope confusions. Correct option positions were reordered with corresponding bilingual analyses; drafts were rereviewed and fingerprints renewed. No published question was changed.
limitations: This is a batch of ongoing whole-book work, not all gaps completed.
Stable source candidate IDs remain distinct from finalized manual sentence boundaries.
